components.name: Chart/Bar
components.description: Compare values across categories. Bars always start at zero. Variants: Vertical, Grouped (≤3 series), Stacked (≤4 segments, rounded on the value end only), Horizontal (long labels, ranking). React: <BarChart variant data series />. Bar geometry is data — it is not token-bound; thickness, gap and radius are (chart/bar/*).

Usage
Rules that keep the chart honest and readable.
The value axis starts at 0 — never truncate bars.
Sort categories by value unless the order is natural (time, steps).
Radius only on the value end of a bar; stacked segments are square inside.
Mobile: more than 6 categories → switch to Horizontal or scroll the plot.
Many categories?
Over 12 categories, use Chart/Lollipop — thinner marks read faster.
Spec
Library-neutral contract — maps to Recharts, ECharts, D3, Visx, SwiftUI Charts or Compose.
Field
Definition
Purpose
Compares values across categories. Bars always start at zero.
Encoding
x ← category · y ← value (from 0) · colour ← series · stack ← segment
Interaction
Hover / tap shows Chart/Tooltip; click selects for drill-down; legend toggles series.
Accessibility
Text summary under the chart (“May is highest: 92”); table view toggle;
